title: Read the board from a git ref (--board-ref) without checkout
description:
Problem: multi-clone and multi-agent work. Each checkout or worktree reads only its own board copy, so an agent in a stale worktree misses comments (this alone would have prevented the M10 agent in Papyrus missing comments). Verified: kbs list and kbs show have no option to read from a git ref (no board-ref flag in CLI help for list or show; kbs show has only --json, --raw and --project-root).

Acceptance:
- A read-only mode, for example kbs --board-ref origin/develop list|show|now|ready, or an environment variable KBS_BOARD_REF, that reads the board from a git ref without checking it out and without writing anything to the working tree.
- Works from any worktree; if the ref is not fetched, a clear message says to fetch (optionally --fetch).
- Write commands refuse to run with a board ref set.
- Gherkin scenario: a comment present only on origin/develop is visible via --board-ref from a stale clone.
right_now_summary: The team plans read-only board access from a Git ref without checkout, with clear fetch guidance and write protection.
